matrix.clarification: These are CLI/daemon pairings, not the older declarative creator/requester-language labels. Each pairing uses two separate legitimate fixture users and actual installed services; the service binary never changes when selecting the CLI.

preflight.observation: Reviewed read-only host context has actual systemd252/running, user managers, writable delegated cgroups and required tools/Python3.12. Normal tool sandbox PID1/cgroup restrictions are not an installed acceptance result.
preflight.effect: No service/user/package/runtime action is authorized by this metadata alone; use a later specifically reviewed escalation for exact owned fixture users.

required_offers_before_runner_or_executi: ONE exact coherent runtime head and its normal Go/Rust release archives, checksum/installer hashes and packaged CLI/daemon/integration byte hashes; no required coordinator build options or helpers.
Parent explicitly offers native up/invite/private join/cold original/default-no/current provider/readiness and service support on those exact packages.
Freeze exact executable/support/cases/package/user-service bindings and supported native help spellings before first execution; no invented up flags or argv secrets.
Legitimate isolated actual users with unique UID/GID and working user@UID managers; explicit authorization for install/linger/service lifecycle in those users only.
A controlled documented harness fixture that runs the actual packaged adapter handshake. Readiness must be observed; no real model/remote-work success is invented.

minimum_fixture.users: Two fresh unique owned Unix users A/Alice and B/Bob for EACH pairing, eight total across the4pairings. No shared HOME/state/original/private credential. Distinct actual host and original-person public keys.
minimum_fixture.packages: Use checksum-verified normal installers. Pin service ExecStart daemon path/PID/exe hash to offered daemon package. Invoke chosen normal packaged CLI via explicit immutable path for cross-CLI pairs; never overwrite/repoint installed service or use a foreground process as its replacement.
minimum_fixture.network: Fresh actual coordinator-free create at A; private signed PSI2 handoff to cold B. Bob original remains only on B. Bob supplies owner/F original consent there; Alice root supplies actual admission. Both requester decisions are distinct default-no. No old positive test function, coordinator, helper or actual private-key/store copy.
minimum_fixture.listeners: Use fresh normal install/up peer/bootstrap defaults and actual signed private contact hints for controlled local/LAN reachability. No manual serve/listener fix that masks installed defaults. Existing units must stay byte-exact; a required repair is reported, not silently rewritten.
minimum_fixture.integration: Shipped integration plus independently controlled local harness fixture drives real packaged adapter/credential/session/peerspan_ready handshake. A normal no-start preparation is not adapter readiness. No live model task is called.
minimum_fixture.profile: Keep one actual project/profile per user for reuse/conflict/credential checks. Record original expiry/scopes/routes/agent/session/adapter IDs and hash-only profile/credential custody; do not export credential token bytes.
minimum_fixture.normal_time: Actual UTC and real transport/service timers for baseline installed flow. If case6 uses a short finite provider, set its exact short deadline through a documented explicit owner review BEFORE selection; wait for that real deadline without reset. No hidden DEC clock/environment/unit change is presumed.
minimum_fixture.ownership: No use of historical installed homes/accounts whose cleanup was intentional. Existing historical receipts remain evidence, not a constructor. No ordinary setup SQL or copied stores/daemon keys.

cases.name: installed_up_fresh_create_uses_actual_service_and_no_coordinator
steps: Install both owned users through normal verified packages; observe real user unit/PID/socket/ExecStart and offered daemon hash, state0700/socket+DB+lock0600/account ownership.

Run A native up create with no-start and explicit Alice identity through documented surface. Current DEC creator original provider, actual no-coordinator descriptor and valid current authority precede attachment/profile preparation.
Record process/unit/profile/public authority identities and no coordinator/helper configuration. No newly invented creator device ceremony.
observations: Actual user-service evidence; exact package/source/PID/socket hashes and public provider.

cases.name: installed_up_pending_and_default_no_preserve_request_and_do_not_attach
steps: Mint actual signed private intro at A. B runs documented private join/up as an explicit cold-original choice; verify review before identity publication and private requester-code disclosure only at the allowed explicit display action.

Use actual PTY with two terminals. At exact owner selection blank-decline, then automatic pending up must retain the SAME request/person/host/device/review with no redisplayed code, no new create/join, no service rewrite and no B attachment.

Explicitly select the already reviewed offer. Coordinate actual Alice-root admission and Bob-original F on their own users while B guide remains open. Blank-decline final consent separately; retain selected prefix/no adoption/provider/B attachment.
observations: Both distinct default-no decisions; protected PTY capture, public status and stopped coherent normative private-row/key hashes.
No code/secret in status/activity/service journal. No original key copied from A to B.

cases.name: installed_up_rejects_explicit_profile_conflict_before_trust_or_enrollment
steps: On A actual saved setup/profile, pass one known explicit incompatible setting through a documented native flag; require refusal before any new enrollment/trust/signature/profile/credential/session effect.
Check omitted expiry inherits saved original expiry when reusing that profile; do not reconstruct it from current time.
Compare exact unit, network/provider/keys, profile/credential hashes, scopes/routes/session/connection. No malformed-token/parser refusal substitutes for a real profile mismatch.
observations: Unchanged durable/profile/credential state and original expiry.
If the public help has no matching flag/binding, hold this subcheck for contract clarification; invent no flag.

cases.name: installed_up_attaches_only_after_linked_and_actual_provider_service_gates
steps: Resume B same pending reviewed request. Only an explicit final yes may commit; observe actual independent local application and usable exact selected owned device before up creates/recovers B attachment.
Verify actual service plus profile, credential, authorization, session and adapter connection; then drive a real packaged adapter handshake through the controlled harness.
Observe ready state only after native and integration checks plus live adapter lease succeed.
observations: Same request/people/hosts/keys throughout, one application and no duplicate attachment.
adapter_ready is real fixture-handshake evidence; model_availability stays unknown and remote/model consumption unverified.

cases.name: installed_up_ready_reuse_and_offline_recovery_preserve_attachment
steps: Ready attached up reuse skips duplicate launch and retains exact profile/credential/auth expiry/scopes/routes/session/adapter.

Make ONLY the original tracked fixture adapter/transport offline through an ownership-checked process/connection control, leaving actual daemon/unit running; poll the documented offline+recoverable state.

Non-no-start reuse is incomplete unless actual launch/recovery is performed; no-start may remain prepared with the same attachment. Nonempty harness arguments cannot be silently ignored when no process launches.
Perform only supported same-profile recovery, then observe actual renewed adapter lease on the same attachment.
observations: No new credentials/session/agent or unit rewrite; no arbitrary UID-wide kill or claimed readiness from metadata.
Observe actual offline/recoverable precondition; do not guess its timing from a sleep alone.

cases.name: installed_up_authority_repair_preserves_identity_profile_and_credentials
steps: Use the exact previously reviewed short device deadline, if supported by public owner flags, and wait until actual provider expiry without changing the signed time/window.
up reports current repair/incomplete for the same selected device/person/host and signed completion. An available original file on B must not become an implicit provider fallback.
Preserve same service unit, profile/credential/session identity/scopes/expiry and operation history; no duplicate attachment, new key/person or guard rewind.
observations: Only the EXPIRED-provider repair variant is planned in this minimum group. Pending already appears in case2.
Fork and migration-fence installed repair require separate valid public fixture prerequisites and remain open; do not count this one expiry control as those results.
If an exact short finite offer cannot be bound through documented native public flags, hold this variant rather than silently using test time or resetting authority.

service_and_private_custody: Use actual runuser identity and user bus/runtime directory; no systemctl/loginctl stubs, chroot/container workaround or foreground substitution.
Hash-only private/source custody and coherent SQLite read transaction/stop boundary; no live noncoherent database copy/immutable/nolock reads.
Protected files/logs0600 and dirs0700; scan known private tokens/codes in public output/journal without printing secret bytes. Published receipts contain only public response IDs/results/hashes.

Preserve first failure actual homes/state/keys/unit definitions and stopped boundary until reviewed. Later explicit cleanup may stop only tracked exact users/units/managers/groups, disable only fixture-enabled linger and remove only suite-created accounts/homes; no pkill-UID/terminate-user or broad leftover cleanup.
discarded_historical_recipe_behaviors: Calling legacy InstalledCeremony/Harness constructors which start/package a coordinator, enable legacy linking or use legacy invite shapes.
Passing a token/code in argv, copying one original across users, extracting actual TLS/private keys for raw probes, or copying an actual DB to make another participant.
Using service-manager recording stubs or installed-binary foreground daemons as installed readiness evidence.
Calling the six already-passed foreground-native functions, treating4creator/requester pairings as4CLI/daemon pairings, or composing intermediate sources into a final acceptance claim.
Asserting all pending/expired/fork/migration repair variants from one positive flow, model availability from a fixture handshake or NAT from local reachability.
execution_boundary: Draft plan only. Zero package installation, user/linger/service change, key/fixture generation, socket/probe/CLI runtime, container or acceptance case executed. Runtime runner preparation follows prioritized merged138 P1/P2 controls and a separate reviewed normal-package/service offer.
